== Hong Kong ==

{{As of|2025|03}}, the penetration rate in [[Hong Kong]] was estimated at 359% over a population estimate of over 7.501 million, with 27.81 million public mobile subscriptions.<ref name="Hong Kong : The facts">{{cite web |url=https://www.ofca.gov.hk/en/news_info/data_statistics/indicators/index.html|title=Telecommunications Indicators in Hong Kong |publisher=[[Office of the Communications Authority]]|access-date=31 March 2020}}</ref> Hong Kong's telecom regulator is the [[Office of the Communications Authority]] (OFCA).

{{As of|2024|03}}, there were 24 registered [[Mobile Virtual Network Operator]]s, apart from the 4 licensed mobile network operators in [[Hong Kong]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://app2.coms-auth.hk/apps/sbo_lic_search/onlineEnquiry?lang=en|title=Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) services Licences Enquiry|website=Office of the Communications Authority}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ofca.gov.hk/en/consumer_focus/operators_information/telecommunications_services_providers/index.html|title=Telecommunications Services Providers|website=Office of the Communications Authority}}</ref>

== Indonesia ==

[[Indonesia]] has 254.792&nbsp;million subscribers in total<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.kominfo.go.id/content/detail/13131/inilah-rincian-jumlah-pelanggan-prabayar-masing-masing-operator/0/sorotan_media|title=Inilah rincian jumlah pelanggan prabayar masing masing operator |website=kominfo.go.id|publisher=KOMINFO|access-date=31 October 2018}}</ref> (April 2018), or a 142% penetration rate<ref>{{cite web|url=https://databoks.katadata.co.id/datapublish/2017/08/29/pengguna-ponsel-indonesia-mencapai-142-dari-populasi|title=Pengguna ponsel Indonesia mencapai 142% dari populasi|website=katadata.co.id|publisher=KATADATA|access-date=31 October 2018}}</ref> (January 2017).
The regulatory authority for telecommunication in Indonesia is the [[Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs]], having taking over the roles from the {{lang|id|Badan Regulasi Telekomunikasi Indonesia}} (Indonesia Telecommunication Regulatory Agency), which was dissolved in November 2021.
